definition: max(4, 99.99th percentile of |G source centered/RMS-normalized audio| sampled every eighth sample)
rationale: G-only traces show near-terminal epsilon errors of 0.0065-0.0092 divided by alpha_bar amplify x0 error. Clipping alone bounds amplitude but all four G samples still saturate Q=1. Use the latest cosine timestep with alpha_bar>=0.01, limiting squared-error amplification to about 100. This fixed numerical choice is not selected by a V-quality sweep; retain the same endpoint for all inference budgets.
limitation: Pure-Gaussian initialization approximates the marginal at alpha_bar=0.01023; this is a documented truncated-schedule pilot adaptation, not exact sampling of the training endpoint. No claim of optimal sampler or unbiased posterior samples.
